Peak RSS comes from /usr/bin/time %M on the bwrap child, which reports the largest single waited process rather than the sum over the soffice tree; cross-check against /proc VmHWM or cgroup memory.peak before trusting the 1 GiB gate.

The image-size delta is measured with df inside a throwaway debian:bookworm-slim container (script lines 48-57), not on the Model Plane execution-core image, so it is not the image MB delta the plan DoD asks for; record it as an approximation.
